title: Bundle dynamics + commitment credits pilot for embeddings & rerank
creator: Maya Chen
description: Run a time-boxed pilot that evaluates a combined per-vector slab pricing model with dynamic batch-credit bundles and enterprise commitment credits for high-volume embeddings and reranking workloads. Goal is to validate revenue-neutral pricing that reduces per-vector cost for bulk customers while preserving unit economics and minimizing billing complexity. This ticket coordinates PM, Finance, Billing, Legal (QSA), and Eng runtime changes needed for pilot metering and reporting.
goals: Design a simple customer-facing bundle: X vector-batch credits for a fixed monthly price + per-vector tail pricing
Offer 10–40% effective discounts for large batch consumers while keeping marginal revenue >= current baseline
Validate contract flow & QSA questionnaire readiness for enterprise buyers committing to 3–12 month terms
Measure impact on average revenue per thousand vectors (ARPV) and on unit cost under typical rerank workloads
metrics: Target: pilot customers show >= 15% reduction in per-vector spend vs current list for batch-heavy workloads
Revenue neutrality threshold: blended ARPV not lower than 0.95x current baseline over 90 days
Adoption: 4 pilot customers signed to commitment pilot (mix: AI-native startup, mid-market SaaS, two enterprise POCs)
Operational: billing accuracy >= 99.5% over pilot billing runs; reporting latency < 24h
pricing_proposal: Tier A (small): 250M vector-batch credits / month for $4,000 (effective per-vector ~0.0016) + 1.2x tail multiplier
Tier B (mid): 1B vector-batch credits / month for $14,000 (effective per-vector ~0.0014) + 1.1x tail multiplier
Tier C (large): 5B vector-batch credits / month for $58,000 (effective per-vector ~0.00116) + 1.0x tail multiplier
Commitment credit multiplier: customers committing 6+ months get 1.15x credit multiplier (i.e., pay for 1 month, receive 1.15 months of credits pro-rata), 12+ months get 1.3x
Rerank adjustment: introduce a rerank-specific bucket where dense rerank requests consume 0.75x credit per vector to reflect lower per-token compute in our runtime optimizations
Floor pricing: ensure per-vector tail price floor at 0.0009 to protect marginal revenue on unexpected usage spikes
risks: Gaming/abuse: customers might split workloads across accounts to exploit trial multipliers
Complexity: billing changes increase CS and finance tickets during pilot
Latency-sensitive rerank customers may see unpredictable cost if batch patterns change
QSA/legal: enterprise contracts must pass security questionnaire when commits are traded for credits
Metric drift: caching/batching optimizations could change unit cost baseline mid-pilot
plan: Phase 0 (Discovery) — 2 weeks: finalize product definitions, legal terms, and sample quotes; align Finance on revenue recognition treatment
Phase 1 (Engineering pilot) — 3 sprints: implement credit accounting in billing pipeline, add per-bucket metering, expose pilot flags in Console
Phase 2 (Customer recruitment) — 4 weeks: solicit 4 pilot customers via AE and SE teams; prepare onboarding guides
Phase 3 (Run & iterate) — 90 days: monitor usage, collect billing tickets, run weekly check-ins with pilots
Phase 4 (Readout & decision) — 2 weeks: analyze ARPV, CSAT, ops burden; recommend scale, revise price ladders or cancel
acceptance_criteria: Billing pipeline records credit consumption per-request and reconciles to invoices within 24 hours
Pilot customers receive accurate invoices using new bundle semantics for at least two billing cycles
Legal QSA sign-off on commitment language and required evidence (logs/KSF/controls) for pilot customers
Finance validates revenue recognition approach for commitment credits and sign-off on pilot experiment boundaries
Telemetry dashboards show per-customer ARPV, average utilization of credits, and number of tail invoice events
